scope: backend-only Claude coordinator callback transport (VS Code UI/extension out of scope, owned by B855)

design_summary.mode_detection: ClaudeCallbackAdapter.mode: panel (wake_transport injected) > cli_resume (ClaudeCliResumeClient configured) > unavailable (neither) -- capability-detected, never faked.
design_summary.cli_transport: ClaudeCliResumeClient shells out via build_claude_resume_command('claude', resume_session_id=...) + injectable run_fn; requires the response envelope to echo back the exact event_id/request_id sent before treating anything as delivered.
design_summary.route_resolution: CallbackBridge._deliver_batch_via_claude_cli builds a CoordinatorRouteKey via fail_on_incomplete_coordinator_route(repo_id, provider='claude', window_id, task_id, session_id) before invoking the CLI transport; repo_id/window_id are required non-empty constructor args (fail closed at construction, no cross-repository fallback).
design_summary.outbox_reuse: No taskdb.py schema change (out of allowed_writes). Claude session_id is carried in the existing origin_thread_id-keyed outbox column (validate_origin_thread_id already accepts UUID-shaped values). Provider dimension is a deployment/config distinction (transport='claude_cli' bridge instance = a dedicated claude-routed queue), never a second callback database.
design_summary.busy_and_unavailable: ClaudeCliBusyError and ClaudeCliUnavailableError both subclass BusyThreadError, so the existing, UNMODIFIED _process_batch busy-catch (defer_batch_busy, never dead-letters) durably parks both conditions. Only genuine protocol/ack-mismatch failures (ClaudeCliProtocolError) retain the bounded retry/dead-letter path.
design_summary.status_contract: CallbackBridge.claude_status() reports mode/transport/session_suffix (redacted_thread_suffix only)/pending_count/last_delivery_at/last_deferral_reason/health, sourced from the same taskdb.callback_outbox_stats() as health(); raw session id is never stored or serialized.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Replace hard-coded unavailable path with panel/cli_resume/unavailable mode detection
Resolve repo_id/window_id/session_id via CoordinatorRouteKey, fail closed, no cross-repo fallback
delivered only after a genuine matching ack; duplicate events idempotent
active turn -> durable park, never parallel injection, never dead-letter
participate in the existing taskdb.py outbox/lease/dedup machinery, no second_callback_database
acceptance_criteria.note: No taskdb.py schema/file changes; CallbackBridge/_process_batch/claim_pending_callback_batch/mark_batch_delivered/defer_batch_busy/fail_batch_transient are reused unmodified for the claude_cli transport branch.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: only task_id/state/event_id/request_id ever reach Claude; no worker output/prompt injection surface
mode/redacted session suffix/pending age/last reason/health; never raw session_id in json output
unavailable panel never reported delivered; unavailable CLI stays pending, not lost/dead-lettered
